# Natlan
Natlan is a fictional nation in the video game Genshin Impact. It is one of the seven regions of the world of Teyvat, associated with the Pyro element and ruled by the Pyro Archon known as the “God of War.” Natlan lies west of Sumeru’s deserts and is characterized by volcanic landscapes and natural hot springs, as well as a society divided into multiple tribes. According to in-game lore, six major tribes inhabit Natlan – the Meztli, Nanatzcayan, Huitztlan, Tlalocan, Mictlan, and Teteocan – each with distinct customs and territories. The region is also home to dragon-like creatures called Saurians that have evolved alongside its people and serve as trusted companions in daily life.
## Culture and Setting
Natlan’s society is defined by a strong warrior culture. The people are organized into tribes that embrace combat and martial prowess as a way of life. Reverence for warfare is deeply ingrained in local traditions – the Pyro Archon herself is revered as the Lady of War, reflecting the nation’s ideal of strength through conflict. Ritual battles and competitions are common, and victory in combat is seen as a source of honor and divine favor. Uniquely, Natlan holds that ordinary humans can rise to godhood through heroic feats: its Archon is not an eternal deity but originally a mortal champion elevated by the nation’s customs. This belief that “humans can become gods” is inscribed in Natlan’s ethos and has fostered a culture where inhabitants aspire to prove their valor.
The tribal structure also contributes to Natlan’s rich cultural tapestry. Each tribe maintains its own traditions, deities, and Wayob (guardian spirits), yet all swear fealty to the Pyro Archon in times of war. Historically, travel outside Natlan was rare; for generations, Natlanese were hesitant to leave their homeland due to oathbound customs and the perils beyond their borders. These insular tendencies began to wane after the nation’s recent trials, allowing Natlan’s people to reconnect with the wider world. Despite internal differences, the tribes are united in defending Natlan’s sacred flame and its independence against external threats.
## Inspiration and Design
The lore and aesthetic of Natlan draw heavily from real-world indigenous cultures. Many elements of Natlan’s design are inspired by Pre-Columbian Mesoamerican civilizations (especially Aztec and Mayan), with additional influences from West African and even Polynesian motifs. For example, several tribe and character names in Natlan – such as Tlalocan, Mictlan, and Xbalanque – reference Aztec and Mayan mythology. Likewise, the concept of warrior tribes and ritual combat evokes the ethos of these ancient cultures. West African influence is also evident; the name of a Natlan character, Iansan, echoes a Yorùbán deity (Iyánsa), and tribal customs in the story parallel themes from African folklore. This fusion of cultural inspirations creates a unique setting within Genshin Impact, distinguishing Natlan through its vibrant blend of mythologies and traditions. Developers have woven these influences into architecture, music, and character design – from pyramid-like steppe ruins and totemic sculptures, to tribal costumes rich with feathers and flames – to authentically capture the fiery, warlike spirit of Natlan.
## History and Archon
Natlan’s Pyro Archon is Mavuika, also called the Lady of War, who presides over the nation’s affairs. Unlike the other Archons of Teyvat (who are immortal gods), Mavuika was originally a human warrior who ascended to Archon status – making her the only mortal to join the ranks of The Seven in the current era. She rose to power centuries ago through Natlan’s customary trial of champions, earning the divine seat and the Gnosis (magical conduit of the Archon’s power). Mavuika’s reign has been shaped by an era of turmoil: 500 years before the game’s events, during the cataclysm that destroyed the nation of Khaen’riah, Natlan bore the brunt of a major Abyss invasion. Mavuika, together with six legendary tribal heroes, fought valiantly to repel the Abyss forces and protect her land. In the aftermath of that Archon War, anticipating that the Abyss would one day return, Mavuika made a drastic sacrifice – she gave up her mortal life and enshrined her essence within Natlan’s Sacred Flame, vowing to resurrect when her people would need her again. This self-sacrifice left Natlan without its true Archon for centuries, though the nation’s warriors continued to uphold her “rules of war” in her absence.
In the present storyline of Genshin Impact, Mavuika is indeed reborn from the Sacred Flame as foretold, reuniting the tribes and resuming her role as Natlan’s protector. The Archon’s return is a central plot of Chapter V of the game: the Traveler arrives in Natlan amidst an endless war simulation orchestrated by the Fatui (an antagonistic faction), and witnesses Mavuika’s awakening. To reclaim her title, the revived Pyro Archon must prove herself through a series of trials across the six tribes, recovering sacred relics of each. Ultimately, Natlan’s narrative builds to a climactic confrontation with the Abyss Order and the Fatui Harbingers. In a standout moment, Mavuika engages in a one-on-one duel with Il Capitano, the strongest of the Fatui Harbingers, on a volcanic battlefield. Their battle – depicted in the cutscene “Clash of Frost and Flame” – shakes the very foundations of Natlan, as Mavuika unleashes her full power to shatter the cursed “Night Realm” enveloping her land. With the Abyssal corruption purged and Capitano forced to withdraw, the tribes of Natlan are finally freed from the cycle of strife that bound them. The conclusion of Natlan’s arc cements Mavuika’s status as a revered Archon reborn and sets the stage for the game’s next chapter.
## Development and Release
Natlan was hinted at in Genshin Impact’s lore long before it became accessible to players. Early references appeared in character stories and the official manga prologue, which in its English translation even used the name “Murata” for the Pyro Archon (a placeholder derived from the term Muratan, meaning a Natlan native). The region was officially unveiled in the Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview video, where it was portrayed as the “land of war” governed by the flame. Natlan became a playable region with the release of Version 5.0 on August 28, 2024, making it the sixth major nation introduced in the game (following Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma, Sumeru, and Fontaine). This update unlocked Natlan’s explorable areas and Archon Quest Chapter V for players, who could venture beyond Sumeru’s western border into Natlan’s fiery territories. The new region brought significant gameplay innovations: it introduced the Saurian Indwelling mechanic, allowing players to partner with Saurians from each tribe for traversal and puzzles, as well as the Nightsoul’s Blessing state powered by a unique resource called Phlogiston. These features leverage Natlan’s Pyro-rich environment and tribal theme to add fresh combat and exploration dynamics.
Subsequent patches expanded Natlan’s content, revealing more sub-regions and characters. In Version 5.3 (early 2025), Mavuika herself was released as a playable character, coinciding with the climax of Natlan’s story arc. Her character is depicted wielding a claymore and the Pyro element, with abilities reflecting the “sacred flame” she embodies. Natlan’s addition to Genshin Impact was met with enthusiasm from the player community, who praised its distinctive cultural flavor and the resolution of long-running lore threads. Critics and fans noted that Natlan’s design successfully amalgamates diverse cultural inspirations into a cohesive fantasy setting, and its storyline – centered on themes of honor, sacrifice, and rebirth – provided a dramatic and satisfying chapter in the game’s overarching narrative.

1.

Natlan Region Overview and Content Hub
--------------------------------------

![Image 1: Natlan Region](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan.webp)

Natlan is one of the seven regions of Teyvat. It is the nation of [Pyro](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/pyro-characters-elemental-reactions-and-resonance), ruled by the God of War. This region is located on the other side of Sumeru's desert. It is known for its volcanic activity and hot springs, as well as the multiple tribes living there. According to records, six tribes exist all over Natlan in total: the **Meztli** (People of the Springs), **Nanatzcayan** (Children of Echoes), **Huitztlan** (Scions of the Canopy), **Tlalocan** (Flower-Feather Clan), **Mictlan** (Masters of the Night-Wind), and the **Teteocan** (Collective of Plenty).

Alongside the different tribes, you can also encounter Natlan's Dragons: the **Saurian**. Unlike Dragons from other regions, Sauriens have evolved and coexist perfectly with the humans. They have become trusty companions!

2.

How to Unlock the Natlan Region?
--------------------------------

Natlan can be unlocked by following the 5.0 Archon Quest. If you are not completely caught up on the Archon quest, you will be able to use a Quick Start function to access Chapter V while maintaining your current Archon Quest progress. In order to do this, you need to be at least AR 28 and finished the Liyue Archon Quest.

3.

Natlan's Gameplay Mechanics
---------------------------

Natlan will introduce a brand new mechanic linked to the Sauriens. You will be able to use those little companions to your advantage, and they will help you during your exploration.

There are Six different Sauriens, one for each Tribe:

*   Tepetlisaurus
*   Yumkasaurus
*   Koholasaurus
*   Ququsaurus
*   Ictomisaurus
*   Tatankasaurus

The Tepetlisaurus live alongside the Nanatzcayan tribe. They are characterized by their brown color and yellow nose, and navigate mostly underground.

You can use the Tepetlisaurus to dig through Fissures on the ground: he will help you reach the other side.

They are also extremely good at digging out hidden dangers or treasures, so use their ability to dig and find different hidden things buried underground!

The Yumkasaurus live alongside the Huitztlan tribe. They are characterized by their green color and fox-like face. They move extremely fast and use surrounding objects to move all over the place.

The Yumkasaurus can be use to move around fast: it spits out Flamegranate Pectin that it hides in its cheek pouches, and will use them to pull itself to distant objects, allowing it to move around even faster. You can also use the Flamegranates to attack enemies.

The Koholasaurus live alongside the Meztli tribe. They are characterized by their blue color and look similar to a fish with tiny legs and arms. They have the ability to swim in almost any liquid.

Those Sauriens can be used to move around in water, lava, or Liquid Phlogiston. This liquid contains high thermal energy and should only be touched when using a Koholasaurus.

You can also use the Koholasaurus to ride Spiritways: ride the Saurien and follow the flow while collecting items on the way!

The Ququsaurus live alongside the Flower Feather Clan tribe. They are characterized by their Pink-Red color and look similar to a big bird. Ququsaurs are the king of the sky and the proudest of all Sauriens.

Those Sauriens can be used to move around in the air. They have the ability to fly higher or perform horizontal rolls mid-air.

You can also use the Ququsaurus to cover great distance with Phlogiston Wind currents.

The Ictomisaurus live alongside the Masters of the Night Winds tribe. They are characterized by their Dark Blue color and look similar to a big bat-owl. They can detect things that are not visible otherwise.

Those Sauriens can be used to detect secret passages, puzzles, and more, through their unique sight. They can also jump higher, move faster, or collect surprising items.

You can also use the Ictomisaurs to extract information from graffiti art to create special objects.

The Tatankasaurus live alongside the Collective of Plenty tribe. They are characterized by their Purple and White color and look similar to a big Bulls with horns. They can smash through large rocks and also dash rather fast across water and even liquid Phlogiston, making them perfect partners to venture inside the Volcano.

Those Sauriens can be used to detect secret passages, puzzles, and more, as you can use them to discover hidden spots.

On top of the Sauriens, Natlan is also introducing a few other new mechanics such as the Iridescent Beams.

These are small defensive weapons that will fire dangerous beams if you get close. You will need to hide behind other items while you try to get closer. Once near it, touch its core to shut it down.

![Image 2: iridescent Beam](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan-beam.webp)

During your exploration, you will encounter these mystical creatures called **Monetoo**. Try to follow them and they may lead you to some great rewards!

The Monetoo replace the Seelies in Natlan!

![Image 3: Monetoo](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/monetoo.webp)

3.4.

### Nightsoul's Blessing and Phlogiston

Unique to Natlan, the **Nightsoul's Blessing** can boost character movement and combat capabilities, using **Phlogiston** as an energy resource. When a character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they can trigger certain Phlogiston Mechanics and Nightsoul Transmissions within Natlan.

Players can obtain Phlogiston through several methods, such as:

*   Triggering the Everflame Seeds or Flaming Seeds of Phlogiston
*   Collecting Candlecap Mushrooms, Flamegranates, Crystal Beetles, and Pyro Crystalflies
*   Destroying Phlogiston Piles and Phlogiston Explosive Barrels
*   Reaching a Teleport Waypoint or Statue of Seven

4.

Who are the Natlan Characters?
------------------------------

Characters from Natlan region are:

*   [Kinich](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/kinich-guide-best-builds)
*   [Mualani](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/mualani-guide-best-builds)
*   [Kachina](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/kachina-guide-best-builds)
*   [Xilonen](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/xilonen-guide-best-builds)
*   [Mavuika](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/mavuika-guide-best-builds)
*   [Ororon](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/ororon-guide-best-builds)
*   [Chasca](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/chasca-guide-best-builds)
*   [Citlali](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/citlali-guide-best-builds)
*   [Iansan](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/iansan-guide-best-builds)
*   [Varesa](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/varesa-guide-best-builds)
*   [Ifa](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/ifa-guide-best-builds)
*   [Pyro Traveler](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/pyro-traveler-guide-best-builds)

Capitano, one of the Fatui Harbingers, is also making an appearance during Natlan.

5.

Natlan's Specialities
---------------------

Natlan has a wide range of Local Specialities which can be used to upgrade your characters. These are:

*   [Brilliant Chrysanthemum](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/brilliant-chrysanthemum)
*   [Saurian Claw Succulent](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/saurian-claw-succulent)
*   [Quenepa Berry](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/quenepa-berry)
*   [Sprayfeather Gill](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/sprayfeather-gill)
*   [Glowing Hornshroom](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/glowing-hornshroom)
*   [Withering Purpurbloom](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/wiki/items/withering-purpurbloom)

![Image 4: Tablet of Tona](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/tona-flame.webp)

Tona's Flame, also known as the Tablet of Tona, is the Sigil offer system of Natlan. It works similar to the Sakura Tree or Fontaine of Lucine. Collect Pyro Sigil and offer them to Tona's Flame.

To access the Flame you will have to progress the Natlan Archon Quest until you reach the **Stadium of the Sacred Flame**, located in the **Basin of Unnumbered Flames** Sub-Region of Natlan.

You can upgrade the flame a total of 50 times. Each level needs 30 Pyro Sigil, and you need a total of 1500 Pyro Sigil to max out the Flame.

To know more about Tona's Flame and the Rewards you can obtain from it, head to our dedicated page:

You will receive Pyro Sigil during your exploration when opening chests or completing puzzles. Upgrading your Statue of the Seven will also reward you with Pyro Sigil.

7.

Natlan's Reputation System
--------------------------

In Natlan, the reputation system differs to previous regions. This time each of the 6 tribes has their own reputation system that you need to build up which provides more longevity to the content.

As of 5.0, only 3 tribes are currently available. Learn about the new systems and their rewards below.

8.

Natlan's Statue of the Seven
----------------------------

The Pyro Archon Statues of the Seven are monuments scattered across Natlan. Interact with the Statues to unlock a teleportation point and the sub-region linked to it.

Upon the release of 5.5, you will be able to find and unlock a total of 8 Statues of the Seven. One statue per sub-region.

Once you unlocked your first [Pyro](https://www.icy-veins.com/genshin-impact/pyro-characters-elemental-reactions-and-resonance) statue you will be able to offer your Pyroculus in order to increase the statue's level. The statue's max level is 10.

To know more about the Pyro Statue and the Rewards you can obtain from it, head to our dedicated page:

During your exploration in Natlan, you will come across items called Pyroculus.

Pyroculus are Natlan's Oculus. You can offer them to the Statue of the Seven in the Natlan region.

Each sub-region has a certain number of Pyroculus you can find:

At the start of 5.0, Natlan will have a total of 3 available domains: one Artifact Domain, one Talent upgrade material domain, and one Weapon upgrade material domain.

These new domain come with new artifact sets and new upgrade materials.

| Domain | Rewards |
| --- | --- |
| Sanctum of Rainbow Spirits | Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City, Obsidian Codex |
| Blazing Ruins | Teachings of Contention, Guide to Contention, Philosophies of Contention
Teachings of Kindling, Guide to Kindling, Philosophies of Kindling

Teachings of Conflict, Guide to Conflict, Philosophies of Conflict

 |
| Ancient Watchtower | Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Terror, Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Hesitance, Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Resolve, Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Splendor

Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord, Delirious Desolation of the Sacred Lord, Delirious Demeanor of the Sacred Lord, Delirious Divinity of the Sacred Lord

Night-Wind's Mystic Consideration, Night-Wind's Mystic Premonition, Night-Wind's Mystic Augury, Night-Wind's Mystic Revelation

 |

Natlan is a mix of Mountains and Valleys. You will be able to venture near volcanos and relax yourself in natural hotsprings, as well as explore immense and beautiful Valleys.

5.5 gives you access to a total of 8 Sub-regions.

11.1.

### Basin of Unnumbered Flames

![Image 5: Basin of Unnumbered Flames](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan-basin.webp)

The Basin of Unnumbered Flames is the main hub of Natlan. it is where you will find Katherine and the Adventurer Guild, as well as the main shops.

This sub-region is also the home of the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, and where you can find Tona's Flame.

![Image 6: Coatepec Mountain](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan-coatepec.webp)

The Coatepec Mountain is the home of the Huitztlan Tribe. They established their settlements between the mountains by suspending their houses owith grappling hooks and ropes, earning their name of the Scions of the Canopy.

![Image 7: Tequemecan Valley](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan-tequemecan.webp)

The Tequemecan Valley is similar to a huge canyon. It is the home of the Nanatzcayan Tribe.

![Image 8: Toyac Springs](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/natlan-toyac.webp)

The Toyac Springs is known for it's natural hot springs and visitors love to come to this place. it is also the home of the Meztli Tribe.

![Image 9: Quahuacan Cliff](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/quahuacan-cliff/quahuacan-cliff.webp)

The Quahuacan Cliff is located high in the air. It is also the home of the Flower Feather Clan Tribe.

11.6.

### Tezcatepetonco Range

![Image 10: Tezcatepetonco Range](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/tezcatepetonco-range/tezcatepetonco-range.webp)

The Tezcatepetonco Range is known for it's dark and mysterious area. It is also the home of the Masters of the Night-Wind Tribe.

![Image 11: Ochkanatlan](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/ochkanatlan/ochkanatlan.webp)

Ochkanatlan is a restricted area in Natlan, with severe Abyssal Contamination.

![Image 12: Atocpan](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/atocpan-region.webp)

Atocpan is the region in Natlan where you will be able to find the Great Volcano of Tollan and the Ancient Sacred Mountain with the Sacred City of Tollan, both located inside the Volcano.

11.9.

### Ancient Sacred Mountain

![Image 13: Ancient Sacred Mountain](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/ancient-sacred-mountain-region.webp)

The Ancient Sacred Mountain is the inside of the Great Volcano of Tollan.

11.10.

### Easybreeze Holiday Resort

![Image 14: Easybreeze Holiday Resort](https://static.icy-veins.com/images/genshin-impact/exploration/natlan/easybreeze-holiday-resort/easybreeze-holiday-resort.webp)

The Easybreeze Holiday Resort is located on Tenochtzitoc, a Natlan Island where the summer event takes place. Despite being introduced with the event, this zone remains permanent, and can be explored at any time.

The Sigil shop is located inside the Stadium in the Basin of Unnumbered Flames.

Genshin Impact’s Natlan region has everyone buzzing, especially on Reddit. Players are digging deep into the cultural inspirations behind this fiery land. So, _what is Natlan based on_ exactly? Let’s explore the fascinating theories about Natlan’s Hispanic, Indigenous American, and West African influences, and see what the community’s saying.

> Natlan is inspired by Hispanic and indigenous America and West Africa  
> byu/ironiccookies inGenshin\_Impact

*   Natlan showcases a blend of Aztec, Yoruba, and Mayan influences through its character names and mythology.
*   Players highlight the misconception of Natlan being Filipino and discuss the lack of Southeast Asian elements in the region.
*   The community draws parallels between Natlan and real-world cultures, sparking curiosity and debate.

Key Takeaways
-------------

*   **Natlan’s cultural influences are a vibrant mix:** The region draws inspiration from Mesoamerican, West African, and possibly Oceanic cultures, creating a unique setting in Teyvat. Understanding these influences adds depth to the game’s world.
*   **Community discussions enhance the Natlan experience:** Player interpretations and theories about Natlan’s lore and real-world connections enrich the game’s narrative and highlight the importance of accurate representation.
*   **Unique gameplay awaits in Natlan:** Features like Saurian Indwelling, Nightsoul abilities, and the mysterious Phlogiston promise exciting new mechanics and interactions within the fiery landscapes of this Pyro region.

### Natlan’s Location and Significance in Genshin Impact

West of Sumeru’s desert lies Natlan, one of the seven nations of Teyvat. Each nation is ruled by an Archon representing a specific element. Natlan is the nation of Pyro, and its fiery landscapes and culture reflect this elemental connection. The [Genshin Impact Wiki](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) describes Natlan as a land of “fiery landscapes, volcanic hot springs, and a culture deeply intertwined with its Saurian (dragon-like) inhabitants.” The people of Natlan live in tribes, each with its own distinct customs and rules. This cultural richness draws inspiration from Aztec, Yoruba, and Mayan influences, evident in character names and mythology, as we discussed in our [exploration of Natlan’s diverse influences](https://www.zleague.gg/theportal/exploring-the-diverse-influences-of-natlan-in-genshin-impact/). Murata, a key figure in Natlan, is depicted with crimson hair and horns, further linking the region’s aesthetic to its Pyro affinity. Players eagerly await the chance to explore Natlan’s volcanoes and other fiery terrains when the region finally becomes playable.

Aztec, Yoruba, & Mayan Influences on Natlan
-------------------------------------------

The post sheds light on how Natlan intertwines Aztec, Yoruba, and Mayan mythologies, offering a rich tapestry of cultural references in the game. The character names like Tenoch, Xbalanque, Murata, and Iansan provide a glimpse into these diverse influences, sparking players’ interest in deciphering the lore.

### Mesoamerican Inspiration: Beyond Aztec and Mayan

While Aztec and Mayan influences are evident, Natlan’s inspiration draws from a broader range of Mesoamerican cultures. The [Inca civilization](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan), known for its intricate societal structure and reverence for the sun, also seems to have played a role. The Pyro Archon’s title, “Lady of War,” further connects to the warrior ethos and powerful deities found in these mythologies. Think of the feathered serpent deities like Quetzalcoatl, prominent figures in many Mesoamerican pantheons. This blend of influences adds depth and complexity to Natlan’s portrayal.

### West African and Oceanic Influences

Beyond Mesoamerica, Natlan’s cultural tapestry incorporates elements from West Africa, evident in some character names and tribal customs. For example, the [Yoruba people](https://fanexpohq.com/the-fhq/deep-dive-genshin-impact-natlan-region/) are believed to be a key inspiration. Fans are also exploring potential connections to Oceanic cultures. This fusion of influences creates a unique blend of traditions, distinguishing Natlan from other Genshin Impact regions.

### The War-Focused Culture of Natlan

War isn’t just a recurring event in Natlan; it’s a defining characteristic of its society. Organized into various tribes, the people of Natlan embrace combat as a way of life. This warrior culture shapes their customs, traditions, and even their relationship with their Archon, the [Lady of War](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Murata). This emphasis on conflict suggests a dynamic and potentially volatile region, ripe with stories.

Is Natlan Based on the Philippines?
-----------------------------------

Players express skepticism towards the notion of Natlan being Filipino, citing the absence of distinct Filipino cultural elements in the region. The discussion emphasizes the importance of accurate representation and cultural authenticity in game design, steering away from misconceptions and cultural misappropriation.

### Addressing the Philippine Connection

While some speculate about a Philippine connection, Natlan’s main inspiration stems from Mesoamerican, West African, and potentially Oceanic cultures. This unique blend sets Natlan apart in the world of Teyvat. A player in a Reddit discussion on Natlan observed, “Natlan showcases a blend of Aztec, Yoruba, and Mayan influences through its character names and mythology,” highlighting the region’s rich cultural tapestry. Others in the same thread expressed skepticism about a Filipino connection, noting the “absence of distinct Filipino cultural elements,” which emphasizes the importance of accurate cultural representation in game design. This discussion reinforces that while cultural connections can be complex, Natlan’s primary influences are Mesoamerican and West African. For more community discussions and theories on Genshin and other games, check out [Z League’s gaming portal](https://www.zleague.gg/theportal/).

Natlan Theories and Interpretations
-----------------------------------

The community’s interpretations of Natlan’s origins offer a fascinating look into how players connect the game world with real-world cultures. From discussions on Inca and Cree influences to debates on weather patterns and environmental cues, players showcase a vibrant engagement with the game’s lore and world-building.

Natlan in Genshin Impact serves as a melting pot of diverse cultural influences, inviting players to explore and appreciate the intricate connections between mythology, history, and gameplay. As the community continues to unravel the mysteries of Natlan, the game’s world expands into a vibrant tapestry of storytelling and creativity, inviting players to immerse themselves in a rich cultural mosaic.

### Exploring Natlan’s Unique Gameplay Mechanics

#### Saurian Indwelling

One of Natlan’s most anticipated features is Saurian Indwelling, a gameplay mechanic allowing players to momentarily embody powerful Saurians—Koholasaurs, Tepetlisaurs, Yumkasaurs, Qucusaurs, and Iktomisaurs—creatures reminiscent of dragons. Imagine harnessing the strength of a Tepetlisaur to [smash through obstacles](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) or the agility of an Iktomisaur to reach hidden areas. This unique mechanic will be integral to exploration, puzzle-solving, and potentially even combat.

#### Nightsoul Abilities and Phlogiston

Natlan characters will wield Nightsoul abilities fueled by Phlogiston, a unique Pyro energy source found in Natlan. Existing in solid, liquid, and gaseous forms, Phlogiston promises to add another layer of complexity to gameplay. How will these different states interact with the environment and influence character abilities? The possibilities are exciting. [Learn more](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) about Phlogiston and Nightsoul abilities.

### Tribal Structure and Lore

#### The Diverse Tribes of Natlan

Natlan’s society is structured around numerous distinct tribes, each with its own rich traditions, customs, and beliefs. This tribal system adds depth and complexity to Natlan’s social and political landscape, promising a fascinating backdrop for the unfolding story. The [Genshin Impact Wiki](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) offers more information on Natlan’s tribal structure.

#### The Wayob and Protection from the Abyss

Shrouded in mystery, the Wayob is a powerful entity that shields Natlan from the corrupting influence of the Abyss. This protection explains the people’s reluctance to leave their homeland, as venturing beyond its borders means forfeiting the Wayob’s safeguard. [Explore the mysteries](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) of the Wayob and its connection to Natlan.

### Key Locations and Characters

#### Important Regions within Natlan

From the fiery Basin of Unnumbered Flames to the towering peaks of Coatepec Mountain, Natlan presents a diverse range of landscapes ripe for exploration. Other notable locations include Ochkanatlan, Quahuacan Cliff, Tequemecan Valley, the Tezcatepetonco Range, and the rejuvenating Toyac Springs. Each area likely holds unique secrets, resources, and challenges for players to uncover. [Discover more](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) about these locations.

#### Playable and Non-Playable Characters

While details remain shrouded in secrecy, we anticipate a vibrant cast of playable and non-playable characters (NPCs) inhabiting Natlan. Each character will undoubtedly contribute to the nation’s rich narrative tapestry, offering players opportunities to forge new alliances, uncover hidden stories, and further immerse themselves in the world of Teyvat. [Check for updates](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) on upcoming characters.

#### Murata: The Mortal Archon

Unlike her fellow Archons, Murata, the Pyro Archon of Natlan, is believed to be a mortal who ascended to godhood through prowess in combat, specifically a challenging competition known as the Pilgrimage. This unique origin sets her apart and adds a layer of intrigue to her character and Natlan’s history. [Learn more](https://fanexpohq.com/the-fhq/deep-dive-genshin-impact-natlan-region/) about Murata and the Pilgrimage.

### Geographic Features and Their Significance

#### Volcanic Terrain and Hot Springs

Natlan’s fiery landscapes are defined by volcanic terrain and steaming hot springs, a visual testament to the nation’s inherent connection to the Pyro element. These features will likely play a significant role in both the environment’s aesthetic and the gameplay mechanics, perhaps offering unique interactions or challenges for players. The [Genshin Impact Wiki](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Natlan) offers more insights into Natlan’s geography.

#### The Pyro Element and Natlan’s Culture

The Pyro element isn’t just a force of nature in Natlan; it’s deeply woven into the fabric of the nation’s culture. Fire-centric rituals and mythology, drawing inspiration from Mesoamerican cultures, further solidify the Pyro element’s significance in Natlan’s identity. Read more about Natlan’s cultural influences.

Frequently Asked Questions
--------------------------

**What cultural influences are most prominent in Genshin Impact’s Natlan region?**

Natlan draws heavily from a mix of real-world cultures. The most noticeable influences are Mesoamerican (Aztec and Mayan), West African (Yoruba), and possibly some Oceanic traditions. These influences appear in character names, the region’s mythology, and its overall aesthetic.

**I’ve heard Natlan is based on the Philippines. Is that true?**

While there’s been speculation about Filipino influences, Natlan’s core inspiration comes from the cultures mentioned above. The current design of Natlan doesn’t include any specifically Filipino elements, and the community discussions largely focus on the Mesoamerican and West African connections.

**What makes Natlan’s gameplay unique compared to other regions in Genshin Impact?**

Natlan introduces some exciting new mechanics. “Saurian Indwelling” lets players briefly transform into powerful dragon-like creatures called Saurians, which will change up exploration and combat. There’s also “Phlogiston,” a unique Pyro energy source found in different forms, and “Nightsoul abilities” tied to it, which will add new layers to character abilities and combat strategies.

**What’s the story behind Natlan’s Pyro Archon, Murata?**

Murata is unique among the Archons because she’s believed to be a mortal who achieved godhood. She earned her title as the “Lady of War” through a challenging competition known as the Pilgrimage, which sets her apart from the other, generally immortal, Archons.

**Where can I find more information about Natlan’s lore and characters?**

The Genshin Impact Wiki is a great resource for details on Natlan’s tribes, important locations, and emerging information about playable characters. You can also find community discussions and theories on platforms like Reddit and dedicated Genshin Impact forums. Keep an eye out for official updates from the game developers as well.

### **The Pyro Archon Mavuika is finally joining Genshin Impact's roster as a playable character!**

Genshin Impact’s upcoming version 5.3 is already setting itself up to be a very exciting update, with Genshin Impact finally revealing the Pyro Archon Mavuika as its next playable character.

Mavuika, or Haborym, is the first and only human Archon in Teyvat’s current roster of gods to have risen into power thanks to Natlan’s customs, so she isn’t immortal like Venti (Barbatos), Zhongli (Morax), the Raiden Shogun (Beelzebul), or the late Focalors. However, that doesn’t mean she is weaker or less stellar than any of her godly counterparts.

Natlan’s Archon Quests have revealed that, similar to the previous Hydro Archon’s vessel Furina, Mavuika has been orchestrating a plan to save her nation from the threats of the Abyss 500 years in the making.

Mavuika, in truth, ascended as the Pyro Archon way before the current timeline of Genshin Impact, serving as Natlan’s god during the time of the Khaen’rian Cataclysm, which also marked the beginning invasion of the Abyss. Out of all the nations during that time, it was Natlan that became the brunt of the Abyss’s efforts of domination, with its efforts only having been thwarted due to the collective effort of Mavuika and her 6 chosen heroes.

Although Natlan was safe for the time being, Mavuika knew that the Abyss would resurface once again in the future to destroy her nation. Thus, she gave up her life to the Sacred Flame to be revived when the time was right, made possible by her Ancient Name “Kiongozi." We’ve caught a glimpse of just exactly how powerful Mavuika can be. She stood toe to toe with the strongest Fatui Harbinger Capitano, and had the capability to smash through both the Night Realm and the Sky of Teyvat.

As such, we can infer that Mavuika may have a more DPS-focused kit, although we can’t forget that all the Archons Genshin Impact has made playable so far are designed to have support capabilities. Mavuika will obviously wield the Pyro Element, and as previous quests have featured, will have the Claymore as her choice of weapon. She may also ride an awesome motorcycle, as her character art suggests!

[Genshin Impact Version 5.2](https://www.gosugamers.net/entertainment/news/73702-genshin-impact-version-5-2-to-feature-chasca-ororon-a-new-area-and-more) dropped on November 20 with [Chasca and Lyney headlining the first half banner runs](https://www.gosugamers.net/entertainment/features/73762-genshin-impact-5-2-should-you-pull-for-chasca-or-lyney), as well as additional content with a new map expansion, a new boss, and an Archon Quest Interlude. Genshin Impact's Version 5.3 update will most likely drop in early January 2025.

In the world of Genshin Impact, Mavuika is the current Pyro Archon of Natlan, known by her ancient name "Kiongozi" and her Goetic name "Haborym."  
  
She makes her debut in the "[Ignition Teaser: A Name Forged in Flames](https://youtu.be/O2ATH__rtQo "Ignition Teaser: A Name Forged in Flames")" and engages in a dramatic duel with the Fatui Harbinger Capitano in the cutscene animation "[Clash of Frost and Flame](https://youtu.be/J4uJsK1gNKg "Cutscene Animation: \"Clash of Frost and Flame\"")."  
  
![Image 14: Mavuika and Capitano](https://cdn.asoworld.com/img/865f059851cb4fb0a1584a711a8bd338.jpg)  
_(Credit: Genshin Impact)_  
  
Renowned for her fiery presence and formidable power, Mavuika is a pivotal character shrouded in mystery, with her past and resurrection offering intriguing enigmas to unravel.

Release Information
-------------------

According to rumors, Mavuika is expected to arrive in version 5.3. Based on the usual time intervals between Genshin Impact versions, this would likely be around the end of December or early January.

Splash Art
----------

Here's official drip marketing of Mavuika:  
  
![Image 15: Mavuika's official Splash Art](https://cdn.asoworld.com/img/bbc4a1c0fe40408fb57fc1113657e852.jpg)  
_(Credit: Genshin Impact)  
_

**Story**
---------

**\*Spoiler Alert: The following content contains spoilers. Please read with caution.**   
  
Mavuika's story begins 500 years ago when she sacrificed herself to the flames to save Natlan, a plan intended for her resurrection in the current era.  
  
At the time of her sacrifice, she held the position of Archon. There was no true Archon in Natlan during her absence, as subsequent Archons were mere humans without the divine throne or Gnosis.  
  
![Image 16: Genshin Natlan](https://cdn.asoworld.com/img/bf209ca918b64344984c3636208fd774.jpg)  
  
👉 **[Genshin Impact Version 5.0: What to Expect from Natlan?](https://asoworld.com/blog/genshin-impact-version-5-0-what-to-expect-from-natlan/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=seoblog-241108-lj "Genshin Impact Version 5.0: What to Expect from Natlan?")**  
  
Mavuika's reappearance involved gathering relics from various tribes, indicating she resurrected decades before the Traveler's arrival and had to prove herself worthy of the Archon title again.  
  
Historically, the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, fought the "Flamelord" and was resurrected to assume his position, suggesting a tradition of sacrifice and rebirth in Natlan.  
  
This history is intertwined with the Primordial One's actions, who distributed sovereign powers through Gnoses to enforce celestial rule.  
  
Mavuika's story is one of sacrifice, mystery, and rebirth, with many details yet to be revealed, including the exact nature of the plan she initiated 500 years ago and the oath she failed to keep, which led to Capitano's challenge.

**In-Game Showcase**
--------------------

**Talent**
----------

Currently, there is no official information about Mavuika's kit, but based on leaks from some sources, we know the following:

**<Source: Uncle 归来>**   
  
\- Mavuika can traverse sky, sea, and land

\- Provides a Nightsoul state to all teammates

\- Deals off-field Pyro damage

* * *

**<Source: FouL>**   
  
**Elemental Skill (E):**

\- Tap: Summons a collaborative attack

\- Hold: Infuses with Pyro

\- Both press and hold actions consume Nightsoul points

**Elemental Burst (Q):**  
  
Single hit, occurs once every two seconds

* * *

**<Source: Seele>**   
  
**Elemental Skill (E)**

\- Tap**:** Summons a divine ring that applies Pyro to multiple enemies within range, similar to Raiden Shogun's ability.

\- Hold: Rides a motorcycle and slashes enemies.

**Elemental Burst (Q)**

\- Accumulates "Battle Will" based on "Night Soul" consumed by teammates, with a maximum of 200 points.

\- The Burst can be activated once at least half of the maximum Battle Will is reached.

\- "Night Soul" from Natlan and teammates' Normal Attacks contribute to Battle Will.

**Passive**

\- Up to 50% damage boost from Burst based on "Battle Will" consumed

\- 35% Attack Bonus from Nightsoul Burst

\- Good world exploration capabilities (fly, run, swim, and climb)

* * *

**<Source: TeamMew>**   
  
**Elemental Skill (E)**

\- Short E: Applies Pyro to enemies every 2 seconds in an AoE, effective even when Mavuika is off-field.

\- Long E: Mavuika rides a motorcycle, gaining Pyro infusion

*   Normal Attack: Gains a new attack combo while riding.
    
*   Charged Attack: Spins the motorcycle, then strikes with the front wheel, generating Nightsoul Points. Pyro infusion ends when Nightsoul Points are depleted.
    

**Elemental Burst (Q)**

\- Uses Battle Will instead of energy, capped at 200 points.

\- Can be unleashed by consuming Battle Will when it reaches 50%.

Weapon
------

As shown in the cutscene animation, Mavuika holds Kinichi's claymore and duel with the Fatui Harbinger Capitano.  
  
So, it's highly possible that Mavuika is a claymore user.  
  
![Image 17: Mavuika uses claymore](https://cdn.asoworld.com/img/de6d0c4248ac401b8650d048eea63218.png)  
_(Credit: Genshin Impact)_  
  
About her signature weapon, leakers suggest to be a claymore named "A Thousand Blazing Suns", with Base ATK of 741 and 11% CRIT Rate sub-stat.

**Passive:**

*   Increase CRIT DMG by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48%
    
*   Increase ATK by 32%/40%/48%/56%/64% for 6 seconds
    
*   Can trigger once every 10 seconds
    
*   Normal or Charged Attacks extend the Blessing's duration by 2 seconds (max 6 seconds), occurring every 1 second
    
*   Effects increase by 50% in the "Nightsoul's Blessing" state
    
*   Duration does not decrease if the character is off-field
    

![Image 18: Mavuika's signature weapon "A Thousand Blazing Suns"](https://cdn.asoworld.com/img/2c471102ea094911932d30d819035df5.jpg)

**Constellations**
------------------

### **C1:**

\- Expands the maximum Nightsoul Points

\- Enhances Battle Will accumulation efficiency

\- Increases ATK

### **C2:**

\- Grants an additional 300 Base ATK

\- Reduces enemies' DEF by 20% in the Divine Ring state

\- During the motorcycle state, each ATK point boosts Normal Attack damage by 1 and Charged Attack damage by 1.5 (increases raw damage values).

### **C4:**

\- The damage bonus from Passive Talent 2 remains constant and does not decay.

### **C6:**

\- In the Divine Ring state, allies' attacks can summon phantom motorcycles to hit enemies.

\- While riding, also benefits from the Divine Ring attack effects.

You can unlock this simply by completing Mondstadt's Prologue: Act 3 Quest, [Song of the Dragon and Freedom](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/301808). Whenever these characters use their major ability, the Nightsoul Blessing meter will show up left of the character. It essentially acts as a way to monitor stacks, skill durations, or gauge the limits depending on the character's kit.
